page.overview:
Who is Pikka Adren?

Pikka Adren was a human female contractor and the wife of Joss Adren during the High Republic Era, who she worked alongside during the construction of the Starlight Beacon space station. During the Great Hyperspace Disaster, she and her husband volunteered to help the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order in their efforts to save the Hetzal system from destruction.

Pikka Adren and her husband Joss Adren were contractors active during the High Republic Era. In the months leading up to the dedication of the space station Starlight Beacon, Pikka and Joss were hired to assist with the completion of Starlight Beacon's construction as project managers.

After finishing their work, Pikka planned a vacation for the couple. They packed up their quarters and prepared to leave the station. Checking her datapad, Pikka noticed a power anomaly on the station and brought it to her husband's attention. He agreed to check it out with her. On the way, they ran into a group of dignitaries led by Shai Tennem who was the station administrator. Pikka found the man very exacting and knew he would not be happy with the power abnormality. Tennem invited the Adrens to join them on the tour, and Pikka was afraid she would have to reveal the problem in front of the whole group. Before she could speak, Jedi Knight Nib Assek intervened and suggested that the Adrens should be allowed to enjoy their remaining free time on the station. Pikka wondered if the Jedi had sensed her agitation but quickly continued on her journey to the location of the power anomaly. She arrived at Conduit 398-GX14 and discovered that a resistor hub had burned out and was causing a feedback loop. Joss told her about a fix but was unable to fit his arm into the space to reach the wires. Pikka put her arm into the conduit and followed Joss' instruction to resolve the issue. They went to the hangar and boarded the Third Horizon for the journey to Coruscant. During the trip, she wrote up an incident report about the wiring and sent it to Tennem. Admiral Pevel Kronara came on the intercom and informed the ship that there was a system-wide mass casualty event taking place in the Hetzal system and asked for volunteers to assist in rescue efforts. Pikka and her husband quickly offered to help.

The two volunteered to help the combined Galactic Republic and Jedi Order effort to rescue the Hetzal system from debris of the Great Hyperspace Disaster. Her husband piloted the Republic Longbeam cruiser Aurora III above the Fruited Moon of Hetzal Prime, and Pikka served as his co-pilot.
